Growth & demand: With regard to poultry growth, our growth is coming to 7% to 8% as an industry.
So this is still at the 35% to 40% of the capacity utilization, which will give us a lot of volume in the coming year, going to be set for the next few years with this new production unit.
I mean, what makes us think that we can go back to, let's say, 5% plus kind of a volume growth in all these segments, especially the volume growth.
Margins & costs: In regard to the costing is concerned, the commercial broiler bird, the cost of production is almost touching average INR89 during the year.

As far as the commercial broiler costing is there, the day-old chicks being supplied to the commercial broiler division is on the cost basis, which is -- which was INR28 per number throughout the year.
But as far as the variation in the production cost is concerned, there are other factors like feed cost, medication costs, growing charges cost, mortality costs and other product parameters.
Capex & expansion: And capacity, we have 2 plants, 1 plant, which is our earlier plant at Kesurdi, which is giving us around 75% to 80% utilization.
As far as the capacity utilization is concerned, it is to the extent of 48% in this year and the total capacity is 1.88 crores for the whole year.

If you would like to bifurcate the expansion of the industry, we are seeing that more than 75% of expansion comes from existing players because they are better off and they are already having the infrastructure of breeder capacity, hatchery and even commercial farms.
Balance sheet & cash: See, as far as the receivables are concerned, it was INR553 crores in the last year, which has come down to the level of INR544 crores.
On the working capital front, we are having the sufficient working capital in place.

It is almost INR160 crores is the working capital -- I mean, availability, which is sufficient to meet the requirement of all the segments which we are having and the sufficient inventory or stocks are available.
Risks & challenges: If you see the overall poultry, I mean, when we talk of poultry and when we call it as volatile, it is only because of the feed ingredient prices and broiler realization.
As for raw material prices are concerned, I think it's going to be a little bit volatile in coming months. for one thing, the crude oil prices are very high.

In regard to the commercial broiler section, for example, the prices are so volatile, day-old chicks prices are -- even in the last quarter, it was INR50 plus, whereas in the first quarter, it is on the low side by INR34, INR35.

But if you are talking of overall growth, poultry is growing to the tune of 8% to 10% and we are matching that pace as far as overall growth of poultry is concerned, overall put together.
